name: DapuStor
summary: DapuStor Corp engages in the manufacture, research and development of enterprise-grade solid-state drives (SSD), SOC, and edge computing-related products. Its products have been widely used in servers, cloud computing, AI model training & inference, finance, power, telecom operators and data centers. The company was founded by Yang Ya Fei, Yang Qing and Li Wei Jun and on April 15, 2016 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
